articles.title: Chicagohenge: How City Streets Frame the Equinox Sun
articles.summary: On the fall equinox, the sun rises and sets in perfect line with east-west streets in Chicago and Denver. Nicknamed "Chicagohenge," it's a modern echo of ancient sky-watching sites like Stonehenge.

articles.title: One Failed Circuit, One Cut Cable: East Coast Flights Halted for Hours
articles.summary: A circuit failure and an accidentally cut backup cable forced the FAA to issue ground stops at major East Coast airports Monday. Hundreds of flights were delayed or canceled in New York and Philadelphia as world leaders arrived for the U.N. General Assembly.

articles.title: G7 Warns Iran to Stop Arming Houthis as Yemen Fighting Displaces 120,000
articles.summary: The G7 — seven major nations — demanded Iran stop arming Houthi fighters in Yemen. The Houthis recently seized the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a crucial shipping chokepoint, and the UN says over 120,000 Yemenis have been displaced.
